reason: F.5 component gallery and settings (roadmap D32). The plugin now packages the 36 host-locked AndroidX runtime artifacts that Compose needs (activity, core, lifecycle runtime / viewmodel / savedstate, savedstate, collection, startup, tracing, profileinstaller, kotlinx-coroutines) so the gallery and settings Activities run in the plugin process, plus material-color-utilities 4.1.1 for the shared theme color derivation, the gallery catalog with 56 example scripts and live Material 3 previews of all 55 components, the settings dialogs, four launcher icon aliases with their adaptive resources, 10-language strings and locale configuration. Inside the host these runtime copies are shadowed parent-first by the host classes and are never loaded, so in-host rendering, the renderer contract and the minimum host version are unchanged.

acceptance.decision: The maintainer scheduled F.5 on 2026-10-08 and accepted the plugin size growth required by the standalone gallery before implementation ("插件包体积增量可接受"); the measured +600548 B / +6771 method references of build40 (70369027) are recorded against that acceptance. The original Q5 review limits are unchanged and remain exceeded.
